dedupe_keys.name: techno economic analysis of wideband transmission in optical transport networks

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The study couples detailed optical-performance estimation with simulated network loading under a traffic profile and growth rate. Some equipment costs use fixed relative values, while uncertain or immature-technology costs are varied parametrically. Coverage is a reference transport-network comparison of wideband configurations. The outputs identify conditions where each design becomes more cost-effective. Relative costs and scenario assumptions are not observed procurement prices, and the metadata do not expose a full cost database. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
